metrics.title: Ma'aunin on-chain
metrics.exported: An fitar da ma'auni a matsayin CSV.
metrics.sparklineLabel: Yanayin da ya faru a cikin sa'o'i 24 da suka gabata

blockHeight.label: Tsawon block
blockHeight.description: Yawan katako da aka samar tun lokacin da aka fara halitta yana ƙaruwa da ɗaya da kowane sabon katako.

totalTransactions.label: Mu'amaloli
totalTransactions.description: Jimlar ma'amaloli da cibiyar sadarwar ta aiwatar tun lokacin da aka fara.

txPerBlock.label: Mu'amaloli a kowane block
txPerBlock.description: Matsakaicin adadin ma'amaloli da aka haɗa a kowane bangare, a kan bangarorin 100 na ƙarshe.

blockTime.label: Lokacin block
blockTime.description: Matsakaicin lokaci tsakanin bangarori masu biyowa, auna a cikin bangarori 100 na ƙarshe.

inflation.label: Ƙarfin kuɗi
inflation.description: Kudin shekara-shekara da ake yin sabbin tokens don yabon masu saka jari da kuma tallafawa tarin jama'a.

stakingApr.label: APR na staking
stakingApr.description: An kiyasta dawowar shekara-shekara akan alamun da aka saka hannun jari, kafin kwamiti na tabbatarwa.
stakingApr.formula: APR = tsada × (1 − harajin al'umma) ÷ bonded ratio

bondedTokens.label: Token da aka ɗaure
bondedTokens.description: A halin yanzu ana amfani da tokens tare da masu tabbatarwa masu aiki.

totalSupply.label: Jimillar samarwa
totalSupply.description: Kowane alamar da ke akwai, ciki har da waɗanda aka saka a ciki. Yana girma tare da hauhawar farashin.

communityPool.label: Asusun al'umma
communityPool.description: Tokens suna sarrafawa ta hanyar gudanarwa a kan sarkar. Wani ɓangare na ƙimar farashi yana shigowa; shawarwari masu nasara suna kashe shi.
communityPool.formula: Ƙarfin yana girma ta hanyar samarwa × ƙaruwa × harajin al'umma

poolValue.label: Darajar Ruwan Ruwa
poolValue.description: Kimanin darajar dala na Amurka na tarin jama'a a farashin alamar da aka kwaikwaya.
